responsibility: Implements the loop distribution pass that splits a loop or small perfect nest into multiple loops or builtin-style kernels based on dependence structure. It finds seed statements, builds reduced dependence graphs and partition graphs, merges and breaks SCCs using compile-time and runtime alias information, creates runtime alias checks and loop versioning when needed, recognizes distribution-to-builtin patterns such as memset/memcpy/strlen-like reductions, and rewrites loop nests for improved vectorization and parallelism.
